messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: high 5xx spike detected in ap-south-1 / az1 — error-rate > 12% across serving cluster. Alert group: inference-serving-ap-south-1.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident P123456 fired, urgency: high. On-call: @kevin.
kevin: acking. I'm on it, jumping in.
kevin: quick check — is this traffic or infra (OOM/evictions)?
elaine: seen some KV-cache eviction alerts and nodeOOMs in the logs. Noticed recent rolling upgrade earlier today.
kevin: copy. pulling logs.
sanjay: saw increased host evictions in az1 starting ~11:05 UTC, pod restarts climbing. Could be kernel oom or GPU oom.
dave: services reporting 502/504 from runtime mux; backend returns: "kv-cache-miss-exec-failure" in a bunch of stacks.
kevin: running query: ```for host in $(kubectl get pods -l role=runtime -o name); do kubectl logs $host | tail -n 80 | grep -E "OOM|evict|kvcache"; done```
kevin: output shows repeated: "killed process 1821 (runtime) total-vm:..." and "evicting kvcache shard".
infra-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: "If >=3 nodes OOM in same AZ -> consider capacity divert + immediate autoscaler release; confirm model fallback if L3 failures."
maria-cs: customer impact — we have 3 external customers reporting increased latency and 5xx in the last 10 minutes. CS is triaging.
kevin: starting failover plan: 1) activate routing-divert to ap-south-2 for customer-facing routes, 2) scale dedicated pool in ap-south-2 by +30% (temp), 3) enable fallback model variant (cpu-quantized) for bursty routes.
elaine: +1. Can we do a soft divert first (10%) to validate?
sanjay: recommend fast divert 40% then 100% if error rate persists. AZ1 looks unstable.
kevin: initiating partial divert via routing API: ```POST /v1/routing/divert
{
  "from_region": "ap-south-1",
  "to_region": "ap-south-2",
  "percentage": 40,
  "reason": "az1 OOM evictions"
}
```
pagerduty-bot: @kevin marked P123456 acknowledged. Escalation timer paused.
kevin: actioned divert, monitoring. telemetry shows 12% drop in error rate on diverted traffic immediate.
dave: autoscaler request submitted to infra: "scale-dedicated ap-south-2 +6 gpus for 45m" — ticket T-9832.
elaine: enabling fallback model parity: setting model-routing policy to fallback to "redwood/quant-1.5b" for routes matching customer-tier:standard. Doing canary with 5% first.
kevin: canary started. No regression in outputs so far (quick manual checks).
maria-cs: posting customer-facing note to status page: "We've detected degraded performance in ap-south-1; traffic is being routed to another region; some requests may see increased latency. We're investigating." :memo:
sanjay: note — node OOM root cause still unknown. Kernel OOM logs show high pinned memory from CUDNN allocs + runaway batchworker processes.
kevin: killing runaway batchworker pods in az1 for now, running: ```kubectl delete pod -l app=batchworker -n serving --field-selector=status.phase=Running --grace-period=0```
kevin: eviction alerts reduced after killing culprit pods. CPU/GPU utilization in az1 slightly down, but still some restarts.
ave (infra-runbook-bot reaction): :white_check_mark: suggested next step: redeploy runtime with memory caps on batchworkers and increase evictionThreshold to 95% on az1 hosts.
dave: submitted hotfix PR to runtime config, patch: ```- name: BATCHWORKER_MAX_MEM
  value: "8G"
- runtime.evictionThreshold: 0.95``` — rolling out to az1 only.
elaine: rolling patch now to 30% of az1 hosts as canary.
kevin: monitoring stackdriver — 5xx rate down to 3% overall after divert + batchworker kill + canary patch.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation policy: next level will page SRE-lead if ack > 10m without containment. Already acked by @kevin.
maria-cs: customers notified individually: two large customers emailed; CS on call. One asked if SLA credit will apply. Recording for postmortem.
sanjay: starting snapshot forensics: saving VM and container logs + /var/log/kern for the hour before evictions.
kevin: plan for next 30m: finish rolling patch, increase divert to 100% if stable, confirm no data-loss, stabilize az1 nodes. If az1 healthy, will slowly bring traffic back with canary.
elaine: agree. I'll own the model fallback parity checks and output diff alerts.
dave: infra done with autoscaler add in ap-south-2. GPUs provisioning ETA ~10m.
kevin: divert now increased to 100% to prevent further customer impact. Observability shows 5xx now ~1.2% on regional aggregator.
sanjay: continuing log capture and OOM analysis. Suspect driver-level memory leak in a specific kernel module used by runtime 2.1.5.
kevin: filing internal incident ticket for root-cause: INC-2026-429. Assigning to infra and runtime teams.
maria-cs: status update posted to status.redwood.ai and customer emails sent. CS to follow up on SLA inquiries.
infra-runbook-bot: Post-incident checklist suggested: "collect metrics, save allocation traces, reproduce on staging, roll driver update, update runbook".
kevin: tagging folks for postmortem: @sanjay @dave @elaine @maria-cs. We'll aim for 72h postmortem.
elaine: thanks all. keeping this thread for live updates. :bow:
meta_note: generated for dataset; single slack thread string with messages in chronological order
